statements.impact_statement: The flaw is in the gz* file functions of zlib (gz_vacate, used by gzwrite and gzprintf). zlib1g comes with the base image, and the app only reaches zlib through the Python zlib module, which uses the deflate/inflate stream functions and never calls the gz* functions. Temporary: remove when the official python base image ships zlib1g 1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1+deb13u1 (DSA-6613-1).
